# Exact inequalities for the area of CRF

The [proof](N6_ADJACENT_CAPS_CRF.md) defines the coordinates and all
bounding expressions. The root rectangle is
`[4s,1-s] × [4s,1-s] × [1037/10000,347/500]` with `s=93/1000`.
A split lists the zero-based coordinate `c,e,f` and a rational cut.
Append L or H for its two children, including the cut in both.
A leaf lists one of these exact values.

| Leaf type | Displayed value | Required comparison |
| --- | --- | --- |
| area | `1-c_*+(c_*-f_0)e_1-M` | `<347/500` |
| top | `L` | `<0` |
| cost | `D_- - D_+` | `>0` |

The largest printed area ceiling is
`745103104318387912408578124941/1073663732062324664391680000000`.
